DIAGNOSIS READY: HIV Encephalopathy / HIV-associated Neurocognitive Disorder (HAND).

The MRI findings of disseminated, non-enhancing white matter lesions combined with normal metabolic panels and a significantly low CD4+ count (implied by the specific HIV panel request) in a 44-year-old male with progressive cognitive decline and motor weakness are highly indicative of advanced HIV infection causing neurocognitive impairment. Given the low CD4 count is part of the requested data but not explicitly shown as "low" in the text provided, I must ask if the CD4 count and HIV viral load results were abnormal, or if there is a history of HIV diagnosis.
